messages.send.title: Send Message
messages.send.description: Post a text message to a Slack channel.

channel.description: Slack channel ID or name to post the message to.

text.description: Message text to send (1 to 40000 characters).

providerMessageId.description: Slack message timestamp (ts) identifying the posted message.

channelId.description: ID of the channel the message was posted to.

chat.update.title: Update Message
chat.update.description: Update the text of an existing Slack message identified by its channel and timestamp.

channel.description: Channel ID containing the message to update.

ts.description: Timestamp (ts) of the message to update.

text.description: New text for the message (1 to 40000 characters).

channel.description: Channel ID of the updated message.

text.description: New text of the updated message.

chat.delete.title: Delete Message
chat.delete.description: Delete an existing Slack message from a channel using its timestamp.

channel.description: Channel ID from which the message should be deleted.

ts.description: Timestamp (ts) of the message to delete.

channel.description: Channel ID of the deleted message.

chat.postEphemeral.title: Post Ephemeral Message
chat.postEphemeral.description: Send an ephemeral message visible only to a specified user in a Slack channel.

channel.description: Channel ID where the ephemeral message will appear.

user.description: User ID of the user who will see the ephemeral message.

conversations.create.title: Create Channel
conversations.create.description: Create a new Slack channel (public or private).

name.description: Name for the new channel (lowercase, no spaces).

isPrivate.description: When true, creates a private channel. Defaults to public.

channel.description: Normalized channel object for the newly created channel.

conversations.list.title: List Channels
conversations.list.description: List all public and private Slack channels the authenticated user can see, with optional pagination.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor returned by a previous call.

limit.description: Maximum number of channels to return (1–1000). Defaults to Slack's default.

excludeArchived.description: When true, archived channels are excluded from the results.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when exhausted.

conversations.history.title: Get Channel History
conversations.history.description: Fetch the message history of a Slack channel, with optional pagination and time-range filtering.

channel.description: Channel ID to retrieve messages from.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return (1–1000).

oldest.description: Start of time range as a Unix timestamp string.

latest.description: End of time range as a Unix timestamp string.

messages.description: Array of raw Slack message objects.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when exhausted.

conversations.info.title: Get Channel Info
conversations.info.description: Retrieve metadata and settings for a specific Slack channel by ID.

conversations.invite.title: Invite Users to Channel
conversations.invite.description: Invite one or more users to an existing Slack channel.

channel.description: Channel ID to invite users into.

users.description: Array of user IDs to invite to the channel.

channel.description: Updated channel metadata after the invite.

conversations.members.title: List Channel Members
conversations.members.description: List the user IDs of all members in a Slack channel, with optional pagination.

channel.description: Channel ID whose members should be listed.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of member IDs to return (1–1000).

members.description: List of user IDs who are members of the channel.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when exhausted.

users.list.title: List Users
users.list.description: List all users (members) in the Slack workspace, including profile information and bot status.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return (1–1000).

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when exhausted.

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the Slack connector. Takes no input and returns the connector health status.
